verdict.rationale: Claude's memory carries context from past chats into new conversations and Cowork tasks, and users can review and edit what is saved. However, nothing in the evidence documents an account-wide custom-instructions or preferences setting that explicitly shapes every response. Missing for 10: documented global custom instructions/preference settings applied to all chats, evidence that memory or preferences reliably shape every response, independent or hands-on corroboration.
